0022600181.text: The Minnesota Timberwolves (5-3, 2-2 on the road, third in the Northwest and 0.5 games back, 7th in the West) visit the Houston Rockets (7-1, first in the Southwest and the West) for Minnesota's ninth game of the 2026-27 season, and Minnesota enters on a one-game winning streak. Minnesota is without Anthony Edwards (knee, surgery; 33.3 points and 33.7 minutes per game this season), Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles, surgery), and Terrence Shannon Jr. (hip bruise), while Houston is missing Clint Capela (ankle sprain) and Steven Adams (calf strain). The two teams have not met yet this season, and the Timberwolves won the 2025-26 series 2-1, including a 136-132 win in Houston on April 10, 2026.
